user.title: Battery Emulator (MQTT)
user.description: Use the Battery Emulator MQTT topic prefix. Since Battery Emulator v11 this is the configured hostname (for example battery-emulator-a1b2); older versions default to BE. The Home Assistant MQTT integration must already be configured.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Battery Emulator MQTT
reconfigure.description: Update the MQTT topic after changing the Battery Emulator hostname or upgrading to v11.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT topic prefix is already configured.
